decisions.reason: As the firm's core multi-model garage door operator platform, it still fits the main residential systems business even if some functions have since been integrated across the range.
The solid wood sectional garage door serves a narrow premium niche and is less central to a large metal-system manufacturer's scalable portfolio, so discontinuation is relatively likely.
A separate garage door operator with remote control is likely to be absorbed into the broader operator family because remote control is now more of a standard feature than a distinct product.
This glazed industrial sectional door was only weakly positioned and overlaps with stronger glazed industrial door offers, making portfolio rationalization likely.
The glazed insulated industrial sectional door supports the firm's thermal, compliance and industrial-building positioning, so it remains strategically relevant.
Because this glazed industrial sectional door had standalone visibility and fits the industrial access range well, management would likely retain it as the main glazed door offer.
